audit: Token/theme source inventory and acceptance gaps
runtimeScope: Static SCSS/source inventory plus selected existing browser evidence. It does not compare computed values against the pinned Fluent runtime and does not certify native OS high contrast or assistive technology.

families.sourceNote: Uses Fluent-named semantic color, typography, spacing and radius tokens, but outline is reset and focus/forced-colors parity needs explicit state-by-state verification.
No dedicated family SCSS was found in the reviewed style map; rendered SVG color depends on inherited currentColor and parent theme context.
Foreground styling uses semantic color tokens; required-marker contrast and theme behavior are not native AT or computed-Fluent parity acceptance.
Foreground/background styles use semantic token references; hover, focus, visited and high-contrast behavior still need comparison with the pinned Fluent runtime.
Uses semantic status tokens; its infinite shadow animation has no component-specific reduced-motion rule. This is a motion/acceptance gap, not evidence of a color-token mismatch.
Shared field styling uses semantic tokens plus local --fui-text-field-* properties and a fixed 32px minimum height; density and focus behavior need design comparison.
Shares field tokens and local sizing properties; Step has no effective behavior and the style inventory does not prove numeric-state parity.
Uses semantic theme tokens and local --bui-checkbox-* properties; mixed/checked/disabled/forced-colors combinations remain unaccepted.
Uses semantic tokens for track/thumb states; no component-specific forced-colors override was found in the family stylesheet.
Group styles rely on the radio subcomponent stylesheet; selected, disabled, focus and forced-colors values need per-state comparison.
Shares field tokens and dropdown-select styling; native popup rendering and high-contrast behavior cannot be established from SCSS inventory.
Shares field and calendar styling; calendar popup, selected dates, bounds and dark/forced-colors states need direct browser comparison.
Shares field styling; locale formatting defects are separate from color-token usage and still affect parity.
Shares field styling; input-state tokens do not resolve the mask/bind-event behavior defects.
Uses custom cell borders/backgrounds alongside theme tokens; focused, filled, error and disabled cells need full theme/state comparison.
Uses custom --bui-slider-* properties and gradients; rail/thumb tokens and forced-colors visibility need explicit verification.
Uses custom --bui-slider-* properties; two-thumb active/inactive rails and high-contrast states need explicit verification.
Family stylesheet has little/no direct color styling and delegates visuals to child controls; card, remove-action and focus theme parity must be checked compositionally.

acceptanceBoundary: audited_gaps means source usage and known evidence gaps were inventoried; token naming is not proof of value, contrast, state or Fluent parity.
